description: Standing query, zero results expected: no IAM write call in the last three days by anyone but the platform engineer's Identity Center role, or by AWS services acting on its behalf

params.query: SELECT dt, actor.user.type AS type, regexp_replace(actor.user.name, '^arn:aws:sts::\d+:assumed-role/([^/]+)/.*$', '$1') AS actor, api.operation AS operation, count(*) AS events FROM normalized_events WHERE source='aws' AND dt >= date_format(date_add('day', -2, current_date), '%Y-%m-%d') AND api.service.name = 'iam.amazonaws.com' AND regexp_like(api.operation, '^(Create|Delete|Put|Attach|Detach|Update|Tag|Untag|Add|Remove|Set|Upload|Change|Enable|Deactivate|Reset)') AND status = 'Success' AND actor.user.type <> 'AWSService' AND NOT regexp_like(coalesce(actor.user.name, ''), 'assumed-role/AWSReservedSSO_InterimOperatorAdmin_[0-9a-f]+/') GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 ORDER BY 1 DESC LIMIT 50

matrix_rows.gap: AWS only: GCP's SetIamPolicy events are in Cloud Audit Logs, which are not in the corpus.
